Canonical constructor/header facts remain flowidentity.Instance, including
ParentRoute/ParentEntityID. ValidateConstruction corroborates the existing
constructor, not ancestry permission. ValidateAgentExecution checks exact
run/declaration route/entity correspondence. O7 owns declared name/owner/mode
agreement and requires O2 facts for nonroot execution. Root identities retain
the existing explicit-root admission; no new fork header is fabricated.

| --- | --- |

| joinSchedule: stage-exit cancellation | Moved to the same exact header; existing arm and cancellation evidence retained. |
| joinSchedule: initial/stage-entry arm | Moved to the same header; A's prepared stage entry/member/arm contributions unchanged. |
| joinSchedule: pending deadline cancellation | Moved to the same header; exact task/entry/control source retained. |
| joinSchedule: pending completion upsert | Moved to the same header; settled handler is not repeated. |
| buildWorkflowDecisionCard | Moved to exact header and gate declaration equality; retained parent is not decision/recipient authority. |
| core/pinrouting.AdmitFlowExecutionRoutingSource | Now requires the constructed Instance plus exact run/route. Both production consumers are listed above; authored-static equality interpreter deleted. |
| semanticview.ResolveAgentExecutionSemanticScope | Requires existing construction corroboration for nonroot identity, preserving declaration owner/name, mode and root/flow agreement. Authored-path equality/template-prefix interpreter deleted. |
| semanticview.ResolveAgentPlanExecutionSemanticScope | Same canonical owner; source-run plan composed before child-run binding. |
| tools.emit | Moved to agentExecutionRoutingSource's exact typed run-scoped header lookup; existing event/schema/explicit-target checks retained. |
| tools.channel activity | Moved to the same source owner; channel admission/activation and activity target checks unchanged. |
| tools.schedule/control | Moved to the same source owner; exact causal mode, owner/event/task and target restrictions retained. |
| tools.notify_human/ask_human | Moved to the same source owner; card/requester/generation and postcommit acknowledgement rules retained. |
| bus.SelectedInputValidation | Fixed constructor values copied with exact canonical recipient keys. No mutable source-row lookup; independent local and explicit-target filters unchanged. |
| runforkexecution.Prepare selected input | Consumes runforkreadiness.AgentConstruction from the fixed plan's exact header/config, then O7. No store read, receiver construction or invented child header. |
| node source projection | Different concept: canonical ExecutableNode plus installed pipeline/header ownership; unchanged node source API. It does not impersonate an agent or construct an instance. |

Source coordinates are declaration flow versus concrete constructed path,
never interchangeable. Existing lifecycle/generation/grant admission remains
independent. Entityless actors remain entityless; parent/source business entity
is not adopted. PrepareInitialEntryLifecycle/FlowInstanceActivationPlan and
A join semantics/B generation ownership remain unchanged. platform-spec.yaml
agent_identity_model.concepts.declaration_execution_scope is amended together.
